blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A 40-year-old passenger died after he leapt off a commercial vessel that was traveling from Lucena City in Quezon to Marinduque on Sunday evening, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said in a report on Monday. The passenger, a resident of Barangay San Rafael, Burdeos town in Quezon, was declared dead
